result:
The build succeeds cleanly and the generated C# confirms the logic matches the spec exactly. The implementation is complete:

- **`RecordDelete`** — upserts unless an existing tombstone stamp is `>= stamp` (`!(existing < stamp)`), reusing `WriteIndexEntry`'s upsert rules.
- **`SyncTwoWay`** — processes every source name in source order, then every target-only name in target order. For each it computes `s`, `t`, `d`, and `m = max(s,t)`: deletes from each side where present when `d >= m` (each removal counts one action), else newer-wins upsert into the losing side. The tombstone is only read. A private `TwoWayAction` helper encapsulates the per-name policy.
- **`SyncWithPolicy`** — delegates to `SyncTwoWay` when `twoWay`, otherwise to the existing `Sync` (tombstone ignored).

All new functions declare `fs:rw` effects, match the pinned public signatures, and I only appended code — no existing operation was altered. The `>=` comparisons are expressed via known operators (`!(a < b)`) since the fixture only uses `<`/`>`/`!`/`&&`.
